admin.cancellationRateTitleInfo: Share of registrations cancelled each month, as a percentage of everyone who registered and either started or withdrew. Waiting-list places that never got confirmed are not counted.
admin.capacityTitleInfo: Starters compared with the number of available places, per month, for the selected event type and class.
admin.demandTitleInfo: Starters and the waiting list stacked as one bar each month, with available places drawn as a line over them. Where the line dips below the bar, demand exceeded the places on offer.

admin.title: Financial statistics

stats.breedDistributionInfo: Retriever breed mix per year, as a share of that year's participations: every bar sums to 100%, so a year with unusually high or low turnout doesn't change bar height, only the mix does. The most common breeds are shown individually by abbreviation (lb = Labrador Retriever, gr = Golden Retriever, fc = Flat Coated Retriever, ns = Nova Scotia Duck Tolling Retriever, cc = Curly Coated Retriever, ch = Chesapeake Bay Retriever) and keep the same colour across years; less common breeds are combined into "Other".
stats.breedStartRateInfo: Share of each breed's non-cancelled registrations that got a starting position, for the selected year. Registrations left on the reserve list count toward the total; cancelled registrations are excluded entirely.
stats.classDistributionInfo: Number of participations by competition class for the selected year.
stats.dogHandlerParticipationInfo: How many dog+handler pairs participated once, twice, and so on, grouped into buckets, for the selected year.
stats.dogsPerHandlerInfo: Number of handlers grouped by how many different dogs they competed with during the selected year.
stats.eventTypeDistributionInfo: Number of participations by event type for the selected year.
stats.fillRateInfo: Starters as a share of available places, nationwide across every event type, per year — how full events actually ran rather than how many places were offered.
stats.noDataForYear: No statistics for the selected year
stats.participationTrendInfo: Number of unique dogs, unique handlers, and unique dog+handler pairs per year.
stats.retentionTitleInfo: New and returning dog+handler pairs per year, stacked to show the split of that year's total. Years with no prior data to compare against are omitted.
stats.title: Statistics
